steps.title: Verify kubectl Setup
steps.description: Ensure kubectl is configured and can communicate with the cluster.
tasks: Run `kubectl version --client` to verify kubectl is installed
Run `kubectl cluster-info` to check cluster connectivity
Run `kubectl get nodes` to list available nodes

verification.command: kubectl version --client 2>&1 | grep -i 'client version' && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Create Your First Pod
steps.description: Deploy a simple nginx Pod using kubectl.
tasks: Create a pod: `kubectl run my-nginx --image=nginx:alpine`
Check status: `kubectl get pods`
View details: `kubectl describe pod my-nginx`

verification.command: kubectl get pods | grep my-nginx && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Deploy with a Deployment
steps.description: Create a Deployment that manages 3 replicas of an nginx web server.
tasks: Create deployment: `kubectl create deployment web-app --image=nginx:alpine --replicas=3`
Watch pods come up: `kubectl get pods -l app=web-app`
Scale to 5 replicas: `kubectl scale deployment web-app --replicas=5`

verification.command: kubectl get deployment web-app -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '5' && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Expose with a Service
steps.description: Create a Service to provide stable network access to your Deployment.
tasks: Expose the deployment: `kubectl expose deployment web-app --port=80 --target-port=80 --type=NodePort`
Check the service: `kubectl get services`
Describe the service: `kubectl describe service web-app`

verification.command: kubectl get service web-app && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Troubleshoot a Pod
steps.description: Practice the debugging workflow for diagnosing pod issues.
tasks: View pod logs: `kubectl logs <pod-name>` (use one of the web-app pods)
Shell into a pod: `kubectl exec -it <pod-name> -- sh`
Inside, run: `cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf` then `exit`
Check resource usage: `kubectl top pods` (if metrics-server is installed)

verification.command: kubectl logs $(kubectl get pods -l app=web-app -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') 2>&1 | head -1 | grep -q '' && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Clean Up Resources
steps.description: Remove all the resources you created in this lab.
tasks: Delete the service: `kubectl delete service web-app`
Delete the deployment: `kubectl delete deployment web-app`
Delete the standalone pod: `kubectl delete pod my-nginx`
Verify cleanup: `kubectl get all`

verification.command: kubectl get deployment web-app 2>&1 | grep -q 'not found' && echo PASS || echo FAIL
